title: Route branch sampling and late-bind trace metrics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a lightweight, cost-aware sampling mechanism for routing branches plus a late-bind enrichment path that attaches compact trace metrics and a small state snapshot only for sampled requests. Goal: preserve signal for per-branch SLOs and RCA while keeping storage and ingest costs low and maintaining PII-safe boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Configurable branch-level sampling rate (0-100%) with defaults per environment (prod/dev)
Late-bind enrichment path implemented: sampled requests get an async task that attaches a compact state snapshot and per-hop micrometrics to the decision trace
Snapshots limited to 2KB compressed and scrubbed via the existing KMS/redaction pipeline
Per-branch SLO dashboards show stable signal with <=10% sampling on 99% of traffic patterns
End-to-end test coverage for sampling, enrichment, and retention policies
Feature flag + rollout plan for gradual enablement (console toggle + env override)
tasks: Design sampling policy DSL and config surface (product + infra) — owner: Marco
Implement sampling decision in routing proxy with deterministic hashing — owner: Lin Wei
Add late-bind enrichment worker that pulls minimal route context and stores compact snapshot in telemetry store — owner: Marco
Integrate sensitive-field redaction before snapshot persistence using KMS policy — owner: Security team (Sofia Martinez)
Expose metrics: sampled_count, sampled_error_rate, attach_latency_ms, snapshot_size_bytes per route branch — owner: Observability infra
Create dashboards and alerting runbooks for sample drift and storage growth — owner: SRE
decisions: Use deterministic hashing on request id + route branch key so sampling is stable across retries and idempotent operations
Late-bind enrichment will be asynchronous to keep request tail latency unaffected; enrichment failures are non-fatal and recorded separately
Snapshots will include only: route decision fingerprint, selected model variant, fallback_reason (if any), per-hop latencies (aggregated into micro-buckets), and token cost estimate
We will cap compressed snapshot size at 2KB and reject larger payloads to avoid unbounded storage growth
Sampling default: prod 5% per branch, dev 50% — configurable at org/project route levels via Console
implementation_notes: Routing proxy: add sampling layer that evaluates deterministic sample flag before invoking downstream evaluators
Enrichment worker: subscribe to sampled event queue, assemble compact envelope, run redaction, sign with KMS, write to telemetry store (timeseries DB + S3 cold store pointer)
Metrics emitted via statsd: routing.branch.sampled{branch,region,tier}++, routing.branch.enrich_ms, routing.branch.snapshot_bytes
Use protobuf schema v2 for the compact snapshot and ensure forward/backward compatibility; keep fields optional
Retention: metadata metrics retained per current observability retention; snapshot blobs kept 90 days by default with enterprise override
